Your first mission is simple: prove that you can get back alive.

Old Residence

Medical Supplies: Data 1

医疗物资: 看来J-Lab撤离的很匆忙，之前我们去查看实验室的时候，里面的数据都早已被人销毁了，但是宿舍楼中的这些数据他们应该是没来得及处理。麻烦你再跑一趟，把里面电脑的资料都拷贝一份给我。提醒一下，出发前别忘了带移动硬盘。

Medical Supplies: Stop Bleeding

Bleeding is very deadly. Although you won't die immediately, if you don't stop the bleeding in time, you'll keep losing HP. Bandages are the simplest tool to stop bleeding. Try to use them to stop the bleeding. If you can't find bandages, you can buy some from the vending machine.
医疗物资: 流血是非常要命的，虽然一时半会死不了，但如果不及时止血，就会持续受到伤害。绷带是最简单的止血工具，试着用绷带来止血吧。如果找不到绷带的话，可以去售货机买点。

Medical Supplies: Food Source
I'm hungry, please get some food.
Walls Have Ears

A crow we were paying attention to called Sunspot went to a gas station to meet some other suspicious crow. We want to know what they were talking about. Could you go there and get the CCTV recording back? Remember to bring a portable hard drive.
医疗物资: 一只我们关注的乌鸦“黑子”曾经去过加油站，跟另一个神秘乌鸦会面，我们想知道他们说了什么，你能去帮我们拿回那里的监控录像吗，别忘了带着移动硬盘去！

Medical Supplies: Check The Power Supply
Check the warehouse's power supply facility.
Check the power supply facility in the dock warehouse.
医疗物资: 检查码头仓库中的一处电源设施

Medical Supplies: Hidden Deeply

All the data you brought back was encrypted, we cannot figure out the actual data. We need a few floppy disks from J-Lab to decrypt the data. Could you go and find us one? It's possible to find one anywhere the J-Lab staff were.
医疗物资: 你带回来的数据似乎都经过了加密，我们没办法从中获取到关键数据，我们需要几张J-Lab的软盘用于解密，你能去帮我们找一张吗。J-Lab人员去过的地方都可能会有软盘，不是很稀奇。

Medical Supplies: Black Hand

We have decrypted the data from the gas station. That crow there is a messenger. He came to notify the sneak attack against J-Lab. The incident happened to J-Lab really had something to do with these crows. We need more information about this messenger. We just found out that he visited an office in the customs. Could you go there and check it out? That food factory the office in, it's not that simple.
医疗物资: 我们解开了加油站的数据。会面者这似乎是一个传话人。他是来通知对J-Lab的偷袭计划的，看来J-Lab发生的事情真的和这些乌鸦有关。我们需要找到这个传话人的信息，据说他曾经去过一个海关办公室，你能去那里看看吗，或许这里不只是食品工厂这么简单？

Medical Supplies: Gamer 1

What a boring place... It's going to be totally different if we have a gaming console here. Could you find me a console called FC (Future Computer)? I happen to have an FC cassette. Oh, don't forget to find a controller too.
医疗物资: 这个地方太无聊了，如果能有一个游戏机，那就全都不一样了。你能帮我找来一台FC(Future Computer)游戏机吗？我刚好有一个FC卡带。对了，别忘了找个手柄回来。

Medical Supplies: Gamer 2
The console you brought me is broken. But it's okay! Help me find these parts, I will fix it!
医疗物资: 你给我带来的游戏机是坏掉的，不过没关系，帮我找些零件来，我就能修好它！

Medical Supplies: High-Score Player
Break Tom's record in the game Brick Breaker.

Medical Supplies: Gamer 5
Aw, man... Blokkle Bobble is totally unplayable with this monochrome TV! Guess we need to upgrade it to a colored one. Help me find some parts!
医疗物资: 哇，这单色电视机完全不能用来玩块块龙啊！看来我们要把他升级成彩电了！帮我找些零件回来吧！

Medical Supplies: Gamer 6

I finally broke through 1000 points. And I'm also tired of this game. You can try this if you want. See if you can break my record. By the way, when I was a kid I always wanted to play a game called Duckland, and I saw the grown-ups having a lot of fun playing it, so could you help me find one?
医疗物资: 我终于突破1000分了！不过这个我也玩腻了，没事的话，你也可以来试试，看看能不能打破我的记录！话说回来，小时候我一直想玩一个叫做鸭子大陆的游戏，我看大人们都玩的很开心，所以你能帮我找一个来吗？

医疗物资: 鸭子大陆竟然要记忆卡？否则一关机就只能从头开始玩了，这也太折磨了！帮我找回来一个记忆卡吧,求你了！

Medical Supplies: Gamer 3
Assembling a gaming console is also fun! This time I'll leave the fun to you! Try the game by the way!
医疗物资: 组装游戏机也是非常快乐的！这次我就把这个乐趣让给你吧！顺便试试游戏！
